scripts.bootstrap:cdk: cd cdk && npx ts-node --prefer-ts-exts bin/cdk.ts && cdk bootstrap --app "npx ts-node --prefer-ts-exts bin/cdk.ts" --profile <PROFILENAMEHERE> aws://<CDK_DEFAULT_ACCOUNT>/<CDK_DEFAULT_REGION>
scripts.deploy:cert: export AWS_PROFILE=portfolio-cdk && cd cdk && npm run build && cdk deploy portfolio-certificate-stack --app "npx ts-node --prefer-ts-exts bin/cdk.ts" --require-approval never
scripts.deploy:domain: export AWS_PROFILE=portfolio-cdk && cd cdk && rm -rf dist && npm run build && cdk deploy portfolio-domain-stack --app "npx ts-node --prefer-ts-exts bin/cdk.ts" --require-approval never
